note: Design v4 S12 Wren's gifts. A run starts with Wren's four basic hands (data/kid/hand_actions.json) in his four slots. Won fights and finished Events offer 1 of 3 new gifts (seeded, by rarity) for that run only; a fifth gift swaps one out. A gift costs the round's one free hand action; once_per_fight gifts rest for the rest of that fight. Fear 50+ still shakes his hands. unlock: start = in every run's pool; floor_4 / floor_8 = after any run reaches that floor; boss = after a run beats the boss (saved in the profile). icon is the hand picture shown in the slot.

gifts.name: Snip a String
gifts.text: Wren snips the string that works one foe: it loses its next turn.

gifts.name: Tug
gifts.text: Wren tugs one foe a rank closer to his dolls; the one in the way trades places.

gifts.name: Shove
gifts.text: Wren pushes one foe a rank further back; the one behind trades places.

gifts.name: Flick a Button
gifts.text: Wren flicks a loose button hard at one foe.

gifts.name: Blow on the Wick
gifts.text: Wren blows softly on the wick and the flame stands taller for this fight.

gifts.name: Hug
gifts.text: Wren hugs one standing doll and its stuffing settles back.

gifts.name: Cover Its Eyes
gifts.text: Wren covers one doll's eyes: this round nothing frightens it.

gifts.name: Pinch
gifts.text: Wren pinches one foe's arm and its blows land softer for a while.

gifts.name: Tie a Knot
gifts.text: Wren knots one doll's snipped string back together.

gifts.name: Brush Off
gifts.text: Wren brushes one doll clean of bleeding, tangles and weakness.

gifts.name: Point
gifts.text: Wren points at one foe's loose seam and his dolls hit it harder for a while.

gifts.name: Tangle
gifts.text: Wren winds thread round one foe: it cannot move and every hit bites deeper.

gifts.name: Lullaby
gifts.text: Wren hums under his breath and every doll's stitching calms.

gifts.name: Quick Stitch
gifts.text: Wren sews one doll's torn part back on in the middle of the fight.

gifts.name: Tip Over
gifts.text: Wren tips one foe over: it loses its next turn and tumbles back a rank.

gifts.name: Whisper
gifts.text: Wren whispers to one doll and it takes another turn this round.

gifts.name: Nightlight
gifts.text: Wren switches on his nightlight: for the rest of this fight the dark adds no fray.
